source_schema_caveat_on_the_negative_arm.note: `traveling` carries the only significantly NEGATIVE mechanism effect, and its deconfounded CDN/legacy rate ratio is the closest of the well-supported mechanisms to the stability boundary. The sign is nonetheless negative in EVERY walk-forward season, spanning both source eras, and survives dropping nulls and controlling for role_change -- so the sign is not a schema artifact. The MAGNITUDE should still not be read as a pure basketball quantity, because source remains confounded with season type outside the 2025 regular season.

heterogeneity_across_mechanisms.reading: Q tests whether the mechanism betas differ from each other at all. Heterogeneity WITHOUT sign reversal is NOT cancellation.

count_weighted_reconstruction.reading: if opposite signs cancelled, the count-weighted sum would be near zero while individual betas were large

competing_explanation_within_team_reallo.claim: arm G's feature is a WITHIN-team share, so it reallocates a fixed team total between teammates; player rows improve, team totals do not, and the exponential link adds team-level noise

team_level_reallocation_diagnostics.reading: a team-level change UNCORRELATED with arm D's team error is noise: it moves the team prediction without tracking the team error, which raises team MAE while player-level allocation improves

card_supports_marker.text: involvement helps one mechanism and hurts another with opposite signs

card_falsifier_marker.text: all mechanisms respond to involvement in the same direction
card_falsifier_marker.evidence: traveling / travel_footwork is significantly negative while bad_pass and lost_ball are significantly positive

card_expected_direction.text: the G player-level gain and team-level loss ARISE FROM offsetting mechanism effects
card_expected_direction.why_not: opposite signs exist and mechanism heterogeneity is large (I2 = 0.912), but the effects do NOT offset: the count-weighted sum (0.024214) reproduces the total coefficient (0.024297) almost exactly, because the positive mechanisms carry ~75% of all turnovers and the negative one ~9%. And giving every mechanism its own coefficient makes team MAE WORSE, not better. Offsetting mechanism effects are therefore NOT the cause.

identified_cause_instead.text: the sign reversal that matters is WITHIN-team vs BETWEEN-team, not across mechanisms. `offensive_involvement_proxy` is a share of team shot attempts: 92.6% of its variance is within a team-game. Arm G pools a POSITIVE within-team effect (+0.0361) with a NEGATIVE between-team effect (-0.1069) into ONE coefficient, which the within variance dominates. The resulting coefficient allocates turnovers correctly BETWEEN TEAMMATES (player deviance improves) while pushing TEAM TOTALS the wrong way (team MAE degrades). This reversal is present in essentially every mechanism, so it is a property of the FEATURE, not of the mechanism mix.
